scientific_integrity: Exact beta-moment proof and analytic summation; standalone finite checker is corroboration, not proof. Earlier results are credited.
scientific_limitations: Fixed disk, radial cusp-plus-linear family with 0<alpha<1, c>0, d>-1-c; compact microscopic arguments; no general nonradial or varying-parameter theorem; equivalent prior coverage in unindexed older literature remains a risk. No independent validation.
title: A Hölder-cusp transition in microscopic finite Bergman projection kernels
